title: Two community projects join the directory
summary:
Two community projects joined the directory, Mirexa’s listing got clearer, and several Portkey model-alias mappings were removed.

The project listings added Rizqi O Chatbot, an Indonesian-language app combining chat, image generation and text-to-audio, and KoboldAI, a browser-based AI writing interface that uses Pollinations for images.

Portkey mappings were disabled for several text-model aliases, including gemini, claude and command-r. Requests using those aliases no longer select their previously mapped upstream models through this routing path; the change did not add a nano fallback.

The model listing now describes Mirexa as an AI companion using GPT-4.1 and names Azure as its provider. Model behavior did not change.
